steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Hot-seating: one person sits in character and answers questions from others — reveals backstory, motivation and relationships. | Key Fact: Role on the wall: drawing an outline of a character and filling it with what they think, feel, experience — builds complex character understanding. | Key Fact: Thought tracking: tapping a performer in a freeze-frame to speak their character's inner thoughts — reveals subtext and hidden feelings. | Key Fact: Conscience alley: two lines of people voice opposing advice as a character walks between them — explores moral dilemmas.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain how hot-seating and role on the wall help develop character understanding during the devising process. | Describe how you would use thought tracking and conscience alley to explore a character's moral dilemma. | What is 'marking the moment' and why is it an effective rehearsal technique?
